sources.contract: Standard OAuth client creation and modification require Google Console configuration and acknowledgement. This capability offers private import, not an OAuth client creation API.
The confidential web JSON contains client_id, client_secret, redirect_uris, auth_uri and token_uri. The maintained SDK guide documents the older accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token endpoint.
sources.limit: This documentation is not a complete native JSON schema; project_id and exact single-callback requirements are Hypervibe isolation policy.

sources.contract: Create a Web application client, download its private JSON outside source control and configure an exact redirect URI. The Python example includes numeric-only client ID 123456789.apps.googleusercontent.com.
Current client-ID examples also use a numeric prefix followed by a hyphenated suffix and apps.googleusercontent.com.

limits: Downloaded owner JSON does not prove native ownership, administrator authority, actual redirect configuration or successful browser authorization.
